title: Kevin Stefanski on James Pearce: He understands what's expected of him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski on James Pearce: He understands what's expected of him
sources.description: Falcons edge rusher James Pearce Jr. is participating in the team's mandatory minicamp this week, the first time he has returned since his arrest for a February incident with his former girlfriend.
